screens.name: Question composer — provider consent off

screens.name: Adaptive question — support

screens.name: Custom answer — empty

screens.name: Custom answer — populated and constrained

screens.name: Voice entry — could not start

screens.name: Planning — loading

screens.name: Research — loading

limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments based on the attached screenshots and supplied runtime account; no independent interaction checks were performed.
For each item, A is the mean of its non-null hierarchy, typography and surfaces scores; F is the mean of its non-null clarity, feedback and accessibility scores; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1).
The authorized threshold is not met: multiple screens and components remain below A=9 or F=9 despite strong reported browser verification.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; offscreen content in a scrollable or deliberately constrained capture does not by itself prove an unreachable control.

Transition captures show consistent visual roles and content ordering, but still images cannot establish temporal continuity; supplied motion measurements address performance rather than every perceptual transition.
Reported 270 layout states, 1,686 target checks, 492 contrast checks and reduced-motion tests support browser accessibility scores but were not independently reproduced.
The 500px constrained captures simulate available height and do not prove actual mobile keyboard behavior.
Retained31 captures are accepted only as supplied historical evidence for unchanged states, not as fresh independent verification.
Synthetic long prose, source entries and layout error wording are fixtures and were not treated as production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
The configured-provider consent flow used a separate controlled build; it establishes the reported consent test boundary, not a real provider transaction.
Current Circles evidence is offline; connected invitations, eligibility, production authentication and recovery remain unverified in this deck.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, microphone, haptics, payments and OS sharing remain unverified and prevent full/native certification.
No representative novice study or repeated physical assistive-technology testing supports an exemplary score of 10.
topFixes: Keep consent requirements and complete sentence context visible around the question group after constrained-viewport scrolling.
Tighten enlarged form spacing and expose optional skip routes earlier without shrinking text.
Give normal-size forecasts more prominence than sharing actions, and keep enlarged history/check-in actions easier to discover.
Standardize disclosure arrows, secondary-action roles and input focus treatments.
Clarify unavailable-omen timing, offline Sky expectations and all birth-calculation prerequisites.
Demonstrate selected-answer acknowledgement and long-wait feedback before claiming effortless transition and recovery behavior.
